description: This file defines a custom Akka HTTP directive class 'CorsEnablingDirective' that enables Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for wrapped HTTP routes, allowing configuration-based CORS support including setting 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods', and handling preflight OPTIONS requests.

classes.name: CorsEnablingDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing CORS enabling functionality by wrapping Akka HTTP routes, configurable via HttpConfig. It manages setting necessary CORS headers and supports preflight OPTIONS requests.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of CorsEnablingDirective with specified HttpConfig.

methods.name: enableCors
methods.description: Wraps a given route to enable CORS, adding appropriate headers based on request and configuration.
